articles.summary: At BuildBuddy, our mission is to bring the world's best developer tools to every company. In order to achieve this mission, we need to build a team that has experience leading and scaling the fastest growing developer tools companies in the world. That's why we're so excited to share that Dan Stowell is joining BuildBuddy's engineering team.
